quality_tech_coins.one_line_pitch: Unauthorized Drake tribute token funneling fees to his (claimed) wallet via UsePaid template.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Countdown pot where last buyer before timer expires directs accumulated creator fees to charity partner.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: velka (last-buyer countdown) + Paid (fee routing to external entity). Change: instead of winner keeps pot, final buyer picks which charity gets donation.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Blind token launch reveals mystery celebrity wallet holder after 10 minutes of trading.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: Unbox (commit-reveal blind launch) + Engram (on-chain identity proof). Change: instead of unsealing name/art, unseal which famous person's wallet secretly holds.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Holders vote one human portfolio daily, Claude AI trades competing strategy, higher market cap gets next-round voting weight boost.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: Humans VS AI (dual competing trades) + BATTLEPAD (market cap determines power). Change: add Mcap-based voting escalation to the portfolio duel.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Famous trader's Kraken/Bybit buys auto-post to Solana with hash proof, community verifies, fees fund the audit service.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: dotchain (hash-linked trade verification) + Engram (on-chain proof of external activity). Change: instead of AI weights, prove a real trader's CEX moves on-chain.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Token fees auto-purchase Amazon gift cards distributed daily to the ten most active traders that day.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: UseNosh (fees auto-buy goods) + Paid (distribute to specific users). Change: instead of NFTs, buy gift cards; instead of Twitter, reward active traders.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Five coins launch blind together for ten minutes, first to unseal gets bonus burned from shared fee pool.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: Unbox (blind launch + 10min reveal) + turfwar (multi-coin race). Change: coordinated simultaneous blind launches; first unsealer wins fee bonus instead of multi-coin territory war.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Token fees auto-fund SOL perp short position, burning proportional SOL supply when this token price rises.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: pile (fees fund self-perp) + Parasite (burn host token supply). Change: instead of shorting own token, short SOL; burns host when token pumps.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Bonding curve progress lights procedural pixel-art canvas, completion triggers NFT mint split among all curve buyers.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: Build (curve progress = visible visual build) + SPLICE (programmable automation). Change: instead of Minecraft blocks on server, generate pixel-art NFT at completion.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Token accumulates fees, holders vote weekly which blockchain to launch on next, auto-bridges and repeats forever.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: DIMENSION (cross-chain fee accumulation) + Humans VS AI (holder voting). Change: add community voting to the cross-chain launch sequence instead of deterministic route.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Five concurrent countdown pots race, fastest expiration steals twenty percent from slowest pool each hour.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: velka (timer + last-buyer wins pot) + turfwar (multi-entity PvP). Change: single-coin parallel pools with theft mechanic instead of multi-coin territorial battle.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Twitter mentions of token trigger auto-trades: positive sentiment buys five percent, negative sentiment sells five percent.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: XLAUNCH (Twitter bot triggers on-chain action) + Paid (automated execution to users). Change: instead of launching coins from tweets, execute trades based on mention sentiment.

new_idea_suggestions.mechanism: Token holders receive verified on-chain ID, unlock real discounts at partner retailers, fees split between token and merchants.
new_idea_suggestions.inspired_by: AirPad (coin + bundled service) + Daybreak (tie token to real-world asset/entity). Change: instead of AI voice host, offer holder discount perks at real shops.
